intro.description: I work across open-source maintainership, platform engineering, research, and developer communities. I care about systems that are understandable to contributors, dependable for users, and documented well enough for someone else to operate.
highlights: Operating Elixpo's release, automation, and status systems

websiteSection.designedBy: This portfolio is part of the Elixpo project ecosystem and was built to keep my projects, talks, research, and community work in one public place. Its visual direction was inspired by Nicolo Miranda, with artwork from Elixpo Art.
websiteSection.futurePlans: I am developing deeper evidence around DevOps, developer experience, and trustworthy AI infrastructure. Planned additions include reproducible incident notes, operational measurements, and clearer links between project source, research, talks, and the decisions behind them.
websiteSection.codeStory: Elixpo began as a way for friends to build together during university. It has since grown into a collection of open-source services and experiments spanning search, identity, publishing, developer tooling, and creative applications. Vivek Yadav and Anwesha Chakraborty have contributed to that journey, along with the wider community that has tested, documented, and improved these projects.

techSection.heading: THE TECHY SYNAPSE
techSection.description: My primary path is DevOps and platform engineering through developer experience: CI/CD, release systems, observability, cloud deployment, contributor automation, and safe self-service. My AI infrastructure specialization is memory management, including caching, context assembly, retrieval, invalidation, privacy, and recomputation. Developer Relations is how I document and teach work after it exists.
